metadata.article_title: Arrest on breach of bond or bail bond for appearance

article.title: Arrest on breach of bond or bail bond for appearance
article.content: When any person who is bound by any bond or bail bond taken under this Sanhita to appear before a Court, does not appear, the officer presiding in such Court may issue a warrant directing that such person be arrested and produced before him.
article.html:
92Arrest on breach of bond or bail bond for appearance

Section 92 · Chapter VI · Other rules regarding processes

When any person who is bound by any bond or bail bond taken under this Sanhita to appear before a Court, does not appear, the officer presiding in such Court may issue a warrant directing that such person be arrested and produced before him.
